TAXO-ROUTE-R1-1110: params.multi = generous multi-membership. Besides the strict link (score_kind cosine) a chunk gets routing-only links to every subtopic/topic within rel_margin (default 2 x margin_q) of its best, above abs_floor (default 1 - 1.25 x dist_q), max_links per level (score_kind cosine_r<rank>), and an outlier gets its nearest node as cosine_soft. Every chunk link score is the raw chunk-to-node cosine. Display counts use score_kind cosine only. Values are PENDING CAL starting points. CHUNK-TAXO-CORE-1109 + JOB. job.text_chars defaults to 8000 characters per chunk sent to the embedder (was 1000): bge-m3 accepts long inputs (limit 60000 tokens), so this keeps most chunks whole; longer chunks are still split and the part vectors averaged. Neuron cost scales with characters (about chars/3 tokens at 1075 neurons per million tokens, so 8000 chars is about 2.9 neurons per chunk at most; the daily_neuron_budget of 8000 still bounds the day). Domain-only back-offs get no stored link: WP6 counts them as unlabelled. Flag off by default. All thresholds for vera/chunk_taxo.py; gate thresholds are starting values to be calibrated on real data and only control whether the Corpus page DISPLAYS the taxonomy. Outbound control (OD-1109-DEMB-3): the only outbound host is api.cloudflare.com, pinned in code (vera/chunk_taxo_embed.py HOST, https) and no api_permissions.json entry is added; server-side LLM calls such as api.groq.com are not governed by that gate. send_allowed true follows v3.8a (Cloudflare data-use terms confirmed); the flag stays off until the owner-ordered release steps are done. HYBRID-1109 (OD-1109-HYBRID; orchestrator decision 2026-11-09 within the 8000/day cap): cloudflare.reserve_neurons 5000 is the ask-time share of the daily budget; the background job stops at daily_neuron_budget - reserve_neurons = 3000 neurons/day, and ask-time embeddings (config/hybrid_retrieval.json: question vectors and stage-2 passage re-ranks) may use the whole daily_neuron_budget, with stage-2 re-ranks additionally held to the 5000 share. Sizing: the first full embedding pass (about 5.5k chunks, about 1.7M tokens at 1075 neurons per million) is about 1.8k neurons, inside the job's 3000; an uncached stage-2 re-rank (48 x 400 characters) is about 6.9 neurons, so 5000 covers about 700 uncached re-ranks a day (a question vector alone is about 0.04). Budget shares, not decision thresholds; they change if the model, passage count or traffic changes.
